title: Bumblebee holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 45 Q66 58 60 70' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='31' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='25' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c9'/>
  <path d='M64 46 L61 50 L67 50 Z' fill='#e63971'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#bfe9ff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-25 38 50)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='48' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#d8f3ff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(15 52 48)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M34 54 Q46 62 58 54' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M30 66 Q46 75 62 66' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='5' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M36 79 Q46 85 56 79' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M26 74 L18 78 L27 80 Z' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q66 62 64 48' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='9' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='61' cy='56' r='2.4' fill='#2a1a05'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='56' r='2.4' fill='#2a1a05'/>
  <circle cx='61.8' cy='55.2' r='0.8' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <circle cx='68.8' cy='55.2' r='0.8' fill='#fff8e0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M61 62 Q64 65 68 62' stroke='#2a1a05' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M61 50 Q58 43 54 42' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 50 Q68 43 72 41' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='41.5' r='2' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <circle cx='72.5' cy='40.5' r='2' fill='#7a4a12'/>
</svg>
